purpose: Minimal experiment closure schema; structural checks in decode_checkpoint, not production admission

header.target: exact UTF-8 tagged target identity fields

record.scope: exact native origin or target scope
record.payload: retained UTF-8 bytes represented as text; null only with explicit gap
